classical_and_foundational_inputs.name: Cohomology and rationality of regular algebraic cuspidal GLn representations
classical_and_foundational_inputs.author: Laurent Clozel
classical_and_foundational_inputs.title: Motifs et formes automorphes: applications du principe de fonctorialite (1990)
classical_and_foundational_inputs.accepted_statement: Regular C-algebraic cuspidal representations are cohomological for the matching algebraic coefficient; their finite parts have number-field models and Aut(C) conjugates remain cuspidal with permuted infinity type.
classical_and_foundational_inputs.exact_specialization: Only GL3 over the fixed imaginary quadratic K and GL2 over Q, with the two explicit dominant highest weights in RNC.4. RNC6 proves polynomial coefficient ranks and the actual finite count. RNC7 verifies conjugation of the full cusp labels and the integer-power normalized Hecke formula.
classical_and_foundational_inputs.status: retained named classical theorem; bounded application explicitly reconstructed and matched here

checked_primary_author_restatements.locator: Lemma 2.12 and Proposition 2.15 (cohomological and rationality specialization)

classical_and_foundational_inputs.scope_guard: No L-algebraic substitution for the C-algebraic theorem; the integer power q^{j(j-1)/2} in CX.10 removes the square-root normalization ambiguity.

classical_and_foundational_inputs.name: Finite arithmetic CW model
classical_and_foundational_inputs.author: Armand Borel and Jean-Pierre Serre
classical_and_foundational_inputs.title: Corners and arithmetic groups, Comment. Math. Helv. 48 (1973), 436--491
classical_and_foundational_inputs.accepted_statement: A torsion-free arithmetic quotient, with the rational split central direction removed, admits the compact Borel--Serre manifold-with-corners model and hence finite CW type.
classical_and_foundational_inputs.exact_specialization: RNC6 uses one fixed level-three quotient for each of K/GL3 and Q/GL2; it proves torsion-freeness and the cover bounds (3L)^18 and (3L)^4, then counts lifted cells.

classical_and_foundational_inputs.name: Cuspidal cohomology injects ordinary cohomology
classical_and_foundational_inputs.author: Armand Borel, Jean-Pierre Labesse and Joachim Schwermer
classical_and_foundational_inputs.title: On the cuspidal cohomology of S-arithmetic subgroups of reductive groups over number fields, Compositio 102 (1996), 1--40
classical_and_foundational_inputs.theorem_reference: Theorem 5.2, arithmetic case; following remark identifies the cuspidal direct summand
classical_and_foundational_inputs.accepted_statement: Cuspidal relative Lie algebra cohomology is a direct summand of arithmetic cohomology with the same finite-dimensional algebraic coefficient.
classical_and_foundational_inputs.exact_specialization: Only the matching explicit coefficient module at level3L; each cusp class with a level-L fixed vector has nonzero cuspidal cohomology and contributes an independent summand to ordinary cohomology.

classical_and_foundational_inputs.name: Polarized automorphic Galois representations, local-global compatibility, Hodge numbers and purity
classical_and_foundational_inputs.author: Thomas Barnet-Lamb, Toby Gee, David Geraghty and Richard Taylor
classical_and_foundational_inputs.title: Potential automorphy and change of weight, Annals of Mathematics 179 (2014), 501--609
classical_and_foundational_inputs.accepted_statement: A regular algebraic cuspidal polarized pair over a CM or totally real field has a continuous semisimple representation at every prime, full away-prime compatibility and purity, Hodge numbers lambda_i+n-i, and crystalline local representations at spherical places above that prime.
classical_and_foundational_inputs.exact_specialization: General RA polarized existence is used before highest-weight identification. After RNC3, only lambda3=(e-1,0,1-e) over K and lambda2=(e-1,-e) over Q occur. Theorem2.1.1 Section2.1 explicitly permits CM or totally real F, all primes, fixed arbitrary iota. RNC1 matches polarization, HT sign, geometric Frobenius and weights2/0. No irreducibility of all attached representations is assumed.
classical_and_foundational_inputs.status: retained named classical theorem; bounded application explicitly reconstructed and matched here

classical_and_foundational_inputs.name: Semisimplified local-global compatibility at the coefficient prime
classical_and_foundational_inputs.author: Thomas Barnet-Lamb, Toby Gee, David Geraghty and Richard Taylor
classical_and_foundational_inputs.title: Local-global compatibility for l=p, II, Ann. Sci. ENS 47 (2014), 165--179
classical_and_foundational_inputs.theorem_reference: Theorem A p.2; definition of Shin-regular p.5; Theorem1.1 and Corollary1.2 p.6 (author PDF)
classical_and_foundational_inputs.accepted_statement: At every v|ell, a regular algebraic essentially (conjugate) self-dual cuspidal pair has semisimplified local compatibility; if the weight is Shin-regular, the full Frobenius-semisimplified Weil-Deligne parameter matches rec(pi_v|det|^((1-n)/2)). This includes totally real fields and every prime.
classical_and_foundational_inputs.exact_specialization: TheoremA/1.1/Cor1.2 give full F-ss compatibility only after the weights are identified. Rank3 is Shin-regular because odd; rank2 has lambda1-lambda2=2e-1>0 for every e>=1. No Iwahori or coefficient-prime lower-bound hypothesis remains. This exact bounded full-monodromy input is stronger than CX5 used, and was directly checked in the primary paper.
classical_and_foundational_inputs.status: retained named classical theorem; bounded application explicitly reconstructed and matched here

classical_and_foundational_inputs.name: Finite-coefficient p-adic Hodge exactness and weak admissibility
classical_and_foundational_inputs.author: Jean-Marc Fontaine; Pierre Colmez and Jean-Marc Fontaine; Laurent Berger
classical_and_foundational_inputs.title: Construction des representations p-adiques semi-stables (2000), with classical de Rham monodromy theorem
classical_and_foundational_inputs.theorem_reference: Proposition4.2 and corollary to Theorem4.3; Berger, Representations p-adiques et equations differentielles, Theorems0.6 and5.19 (arXiv v3)
classical_and_foundational_inputs.accepted_statement: The potentially semistable comparison functor is exact on its category; de Rham representations of finite p-adic local fields are potentially semistable; crystalline modules are weakly admissible with the corresponding filtration and tensor, dual and scalar-extension compatibilities.
classical_and_foundational_inputs.exact_specialization: After finite coefficient capture ADK1 and whole-representation de Rham comparison RNC3, exactness applies to actual flag subobjects and quotients. RNC4 computes rank-one WD parameters and detects every norm ratio. RNC8 derives both Newton slope bounds and integrality at every coefficient prime; arbitrary extensions are not presumed de Rham.

classical_and_foundational_inputs.name: Local Langlands conductor compatibility
classical_and_foundational_inputs.author: Michael Harris and Richard Taylor; Guy Henniart; Peter Scholze
classical_and_foundational_inputs.title: The local Langlands correspondence for GLn over p-adic fields, Inventiones192 (2013), 663--715
classical_and_foundational_inputs.theorem_reference: Theorem14.1 (epsilon-factor compatibility), with the standard extension from supercuspidals to Weil--Deligne parameters
classical_and_foundational_inputs.accepted_statement: The GLn correspondence preserves local L and epsilon factors, hence Artin conductor exponents; it is compatible with characters, unramified twists and spherical parameters.

classical_and_foundational_inputs.name: Generic local newvectors
classical_and_foundational_inputs.author: Herve Jacquet, Ilya Piatetski-Shapiro and Joseph Shalika
classical_and_foundational_inputs.title: Conducteur des representations du groupe lineaire, Math. Ann.256 (1981), 199--214
classical_and_foundational_inputs.accepted_statement: An irreducible generic representation of GLn over a nonarchimedean local field has nonzero K1(p^a)-fixed vectors at its conductor exponent a, and a=0 is the spherical case.
classical_and_foundational_inputs.exact_specialization: For genuine generic cusp components only, conductor <=(2n-1)v(M) gives a principal-level M^(2n-1) vector. Here n=3 or2, so auxiliary levels are M^5/M^3, while original Galois Level remains M.

classical_and_foundational_inputs.author: Herve Jacquet and Robert P. Langlands
classical_and_foundational_inputs.title: Automorphic forms on GL(2), Lecture Notes in Mathematics114 (1970)
